text_block_list.text: Gold City and I are on our way somewhere, but she's been holding her head in pain the entire time.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Ugh, this is the worst. That medicine isn't working at all.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: I'm fine. It's just a little headache.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: It happens sometimes when I'm modeling. Yesterday's shoot was especially tough, with all the harsh lighting.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: But hey, it's not the first time this has happened, so you don't have to worry.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Oh, but I have another shoot today… I hope the medicine will start working by then.
Gold City continues to suffer from her headache for some time.
